name: GraphHopper
tagline: Routing, geocoding, and isochrones API for maps and logistics
description: GraphHopper provides a routing and geospatial API for turn-by-turn directions, matrix travel times, isochrones, map matching, and geocoding. Developers use it for logistics, delivery apps, and map-based products that need road-network routing with customizable vehicle profiles and real-time traffic options.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY or header Authorization; self-serve signup at GraphHopper dashboard.

use_cases: get driving directions between two coordinates
compute travel-time matrix for multiple origins and destinations
match GPS traces to the road network
